Subject: Post-call: ZenHealth SOC 2 & Data Retention Qs

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate Sophie and Tom walking us through the security and procurement priorities. Quick recap and next steps so we're aligned: 

Summary / pain points you mentioned:
- SOC 2 evidence required for vendor onboarding (Type II preferred; need scope + last audit date)
- Audit logs & retention: requirements for retaining logs for up to 7 years for certain data classes
- Data residency & export controls for PHI-adjacent data; potential need for VPC/private deployment
- DPA and specific encryption-at-rest/KMS controls (customer-managed keys a strong preference)
- Pen test evidence and third-party vulnerability assessments

What we discussed we can provide (next steps):
1) Share redacted SOC 2 Type II and a one-page SOC control mapping (attached).
2) Share high-level pen-test summary and remediation timeline (attached).
3) Confirm KMS/HSM integrations we support and options for customer-managed keys.
4) Clarify default retention and export options for audit logs and long-term archiving.
5) Send our standard DPA & proposed redlines for quick review.
6) Schedule follow-up call with your compliance/procurement team the week of 6/12 to finalize procurement path and timeline.

Proposed times: Mon 6/12 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 6/14 14:00-15:00 PT. Please confirm which works and who from your side will join (security, procurement, legal).

Attachments in this message: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026_redacted.pdf; pen-test-summary-2026.pdf.

If there are any other items your security team needs upfront (e.g., full pen-test artifacts, architecture diagrams), let me know and I'll route to our security team.

Best,

Neha Kapoor

Thanks Neha — good summary. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Can you confirm whether the SOC 2 report you'll send is a full Type II with controls and test results or a redacted summary? Our legal team will likely want the control objectives and testing window documented.
- We will need an inventory of the audit logs you capture (API calls, sysadmin events, access logs) and whether they can be exported in bulk for long-term archival. Retention policy is a hard req for certain datasets.
- Encryption: we prefer CMEK where available. Please include supported CSP integrations and whether you offer HSM-backed key storage.
- Procurement: we've attached our standard security questionnaire (ZenHealth_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx) — please complete the relevant tabs and return.

Procurement would like to have the DPA in advance of the next meeting so we can circulate to legal. Also can you include estimated timeline and point of contact for an on-prem/VPC deployment evaluation (if we need a Private deployment for regulated flows)?

Sophie Li
Sr. IT Security Manager | ZenHealth

Thanks Sophie — answers inline below and attachments included. Will get the questionnaire filled and return the spreadsheet tomorrow.

- SOC 2: We're attaching a redacted copy of our SOC 2 Type II for 2026 (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026_redacted.pdf). It includes scope and the auditor's testing period. If your legal team needs a non-redacted version we can discuss an NDA/secure review process.

- Audit logs & retention: Redwood captures request/response metadata, API access logs, admin console events, and infra-level access logs. Default retention on the hosted product is 90 days for operational logs; for long-term archival we offer:
  * Exportable logs to customer S3/GCS for custom retention (we can set up a push/export job)
  * Dedicated Private deployments where log retention policy can be extended to meet 7-year retention requirements
  * Long-term archival via managed export + encrypted storage (we provide guidance and automation)

- Encryption & KMS: We support AWS KMS (CMEK), GCP CMEK, and customer HSM via bring-your-own key integrations. HSM-backed key storage is available on Redwood Private and with certain enterprise Dedicated configs.

- Pen test evidence: attaching high-level summary (pen-test-summary-2026.pdf). For detailed artifacts we can arrange a secure transfer and redaction.

- DPA: linking our standard DPA for review: https://www.docusign.com/link/example-dpa. If you prefer, we can send DocuSign envelope after your legal confirms necessary redlines.

Next steps from our side:
- I will: (a) upload completed security questionnaire by EOD Mon 6/7, (b) share a Drive link to SOC2 and pen test artifacts, (c) send a suggested DPA redline bundle.
- Proposed follow-up: Mon 6/12 10:00-11:00 PT (preferred) — meeting link: https://meet.google.com/rdw-zen-6/ (I'll include our solutions architect and compliance lead).

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026_redacted.pdf; pen-test-summary-2026.pdf; ZenHealth_Security_Questionnaire_Filled.xlsx (will replace with completed copy).

Let me know if you need anything else ahead of the meeting.

Best,
Neha
